how: Sydney Community College runs acting and drama courses (beginner acting intro, monologue, scene and play levels) and a musical theatre course for beginners at its Rozelle campus.
Sydney Community College offers French courses from Beginner L1 to Intermediate L3, delivered online and in Sydney.
Sydney Community College runs Korean Beginners Level 1 (Monday evenings, ten weeks) and Level 2 courses.
Sydney Community College offers Introduction to Auslan 1 and Auslan Level 2, taught by Deaf Connect, in person at Rozelle and online.
venue: Sydney Community College (Deaf Connect Auslan courses)

how: Sydney Community College runs a Coiled Basket Weaving Workshop for Beginners as a one-day workshop at Rozelle.

how: Sydney Community College offers Chinese Brush Painting (Beginners, Orchids) and Chinese Landscape Painting courses.
Sydney Community College runs a Qi Gong Course for Beginners at its Rozelle campus; a free online and Parramatta tai chi and qigong group also meets via Meetup.
Sydney Community College runs an Art Kintsugi Beginners Workshop (four-hour Saturday session) in the Visual Arts room at Rozelle.
Sydney Community College lists Papier-Mache Sculpture for Beginners plus hand-building pottery and ceramic animal-sculpture courses.
The City of Sydney lists 22 community gardens (for example Glebe Community Gardens, Newtown Community Garden, Sydney City Farm in St Peters) that residents can join.
The Sydney Chinese Orchestra is a professional ensemble performing traditional Chinese music (concerts, arts education, community events); amateur participation is not described on its site.

Sydney Philharmonia runs open-entry community choirs (Festival Chorus, ChorusOz, Christmas Choir) that perform with orchestra at the Sydney Opera House; instrumental community orchestras were not confirmed.

how: Fortress runs regular in-store card-game events such as Mana on Tap at its Chippendale store, with free walk-in entry.
Active Locals hosts social group runs through Meetup (for example Tuesday 6pm Darling Harbour and Wednesday Manly runs).
Hands-on sourdough bread classes for beginners (and a sourdough pizza masterclass) are listed on Eventbrite, held in Ryde.
venue: Sourdough Bread Beginner Hands On Class

how: Bondi Icebergs Club's ocean pool complex has a sauna (its cleaning schedule lists daily sauna closure), alongside the pool open to the public.
Wild Ropes Treetops at St Ives and Taronga Zoo offer self-guided aerial ropes courses with swinging bridges and ziplines set 2-25 m up in the trees (a high-ropes course rather than a walkway).
Sydney Outrigger Canoe Club (oldest outrigger club in NSW) runs six-week Novice Programs at Balmoral Beach, teaching paddle stroke, crew roles and safety before joining club training.
Kings Comics, a Sydney comic shop (open since 1986), sells new and graded comics, graphic novels, manga and facsimile editions, with a CBD location.
Sydney Philatelics is a dealer selling and buying Australian, Pacific and Commonwealth stamps, covers and albums, mostly by mail order and online.
Crosstalk Records in Leichhardt is an independent record store hosting vinyl launches; Sydney also has vinyl listening nights at venues such as The Vinyl Room.
A one-off Ice Baths and Wellness Brand pop-up was listed at Beach Road Hotel in North Bondi; regular cold-plunge venues were not confirmed.

The World Cube Association lists regular Sydney speedcubing competitions, including the Tramsheds series at Harold Park Community Hall (Glebe) several times a year and events at North Sydney Boys High School.
venue: Tramsheds speedcubing competitions (Harold Park Community Hall)

how: Sydney Chinatown (Dixon Street and surrounds) hosts a Friday-evening night market with Asian street-food stalls, plus food courts in Market City, Haymarket.
Sze Yup Temple (Kwan Ti temple, 1898-1904) in Glebe is an active Taoist temple serving the Chinese community and hosting celebrations such as Chinese New Year.
The City of Sydney lists 50+ off-leash dog areas, including Sydney Park (Alexandria), Moore Park, Prince Alfred Park and Wentworth Park.
Cat Protection Society of NSW runs an adoption centre in Newtown (by appointment after an online questionnaire); RSPCA NSW (Yagoona) and others also list adoptions.

Cat Protection Society of NSW recruits adult volunteers for shelter care, foster care and the cattery at Enmore Road, Newtown, though shelter-care applications were closed as of February 2026 and waiting lists are common.
Sydney City Farm in St Peters runs volunteer working bees (after an induction session) and Cat Protection Society of NSW recruits adult volunteers, alongside event volunteering listed on Eventbrite.
Sydney City Farm in St Peters is a City of Sydney urban farm growing organic seasonal produce with volunteer working bees and horticulture workshops; hydroponic growing is not specified.
Sydney City Farm schedules a Bush food discovery tour (14 November) and seasonal guided walks; dedicated urban foraging walks were not found.
The City of Sydney's Ideas Lab makerspace at Darling Square Library has a laser cutter, 3D printer and electronics kit with open-access Makertime sessions for ages 16+; CNC milling is not listed.
A Sydney Introverts Meetup group has hosted pool nights at the Shark Hotel in the CBD; dedicated snooker clubs were not confirmed.
Sydney Community College offers Adobe After Effects: Animation and Video for Beginners, and Monster Mouse Studios in Marrickville ran a stop-motion collage animation workshop.
